Subject: Thanks — recap and proposed POC plan

Hi Lily —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned: 

• Goal: Validate that Redwood can reduce inference cost by >=40% for Novacare's clinical triage model while keeping 95th-percentile latency under 250ms for 512-token requests.
• Success criteria (draft): accuracy within 1.5% of baseline, 95th-p50 latency <250ms, throughput to support ~100 concurrent sessions, and integration with your logging/audit pipeline. I attached a starting scoring sheet.
• Proposed POC: 4-week trial — week 0: infra & sample data ingest; week 1–3: model tuning & workload run; week 4: final readout + exec review.
• Ownership: Marcus (sales) will coordinate Redwood side; Marissa (CS) will lead onboarding and the trial run; you to confirm Novacare technical lead and exec reviewer.

Attachments: novacare-poc-scoring-criteria.xlsx, redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf

Can you confirm the success criteria and proposed timeline? If that looks good I’ll send a formal POC plan and calendar invites.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
